scientific_integrity: Complete direct combinatorial proof, separately executable exact finite-field checks, and truthful attribution of classical line equations and earlier finite-field special cases.
scientific_limitations: Fermat cubic surface only, characteristic other than three; point incidences with geometric lines, not solely base-field lines; no claims for arbitrary cubic surfaces. Elementary geometric ingredients predate this computation, and equivalent historical incidence formulas might exist. No independent audit or priority certification.
title: The complete rational line-incidence spectrum of the Fermat cubic surface
